name: Ceramic-Matrix & Carbon-Carbon Composites
summary: Covers the tough high-temperature composites, SiC/SiC, C/SiC and carbon-carbon, used in hot engine parts, nozzles and re-entry structures.

topics.name: Why monolithic ceramics fail and how fibres make them damage-tolerant
Fibre-matrix interphases: pyrolytic carbon and boron nitride; crack deflection
Ceramic fibres: SiC (Hi-Nicalon, Sylramic), oxide (Nextel) and carbon fibres
Processing: polymer infiltration and pyrolysis (PIP) and melt infiltration (MI)
Carbon-carbon composites: manufacture, properties and oxidation protection
Mechanical behaviour: matrix cracking stress, pseudo-ductility and fatigue
Environmental degradation and environmental barrier coatings
Applications: turbine shrouds and blades, rocket nozzles, brake discs and leading edges
